pr.title: feat(dcp): TP-101 contracts manifest + promotion ladder + det-vs-LLM ADR
pr.body:
## Summary
- Adds `schemas/dcp/manifest.json` (new contract registry, one entry per DCP schema) and its JSON Schema (`dcp_contracts_manifest.schema.json`).
- Adds `tests/dcp/test_contracts_consistency.py`: cross-file consistency CI test validating `ci_gates` entries against actual job names in `ci-complete.yml`, and `level` structural checks (L2 requires non-empty producers/consumers).
- Adds `docs/90-adr/adr-dcp-deterministic-vs-llm-boundary.md`: L0-L3 ladder, version-precedence rule, and the det-vs-LLM boundary table (per design A.3).
- Updates `schemas/dcp/README.md` with the L0-L3 ladder and `schema_version`/`contract_version` precedence rule (per design A.2).
- Ships hand-authored `proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-101/APPROVAL.json` per sanctioned-change protocol B.6 (manifest.json is a new contract surface).

## Scope
Schema/manifest/docs/test/proof only. No runtime code changes, no CI workflow file edits.

## NOT_RUN
Full DCP suite, live scanner invocation, PR #862 routing schema enumeration if branch not yet merged.

## Residual Risks
If PR #862 has merged by execution time, its 6 routing schemas must be added to the manifest before this TP commits — implementer must check HEAD state.

steps.task: Preflight repo identity, branch, marker file, dirty state, schemas/dcp/ contents, and ci-complete.yml job/step names that manifest ci_gates entries will reference.
validation: Remote identifies DDD-Enterprises/dopemux-mvp.
Branch is codex/dmx-dcp-tooling-101.
.dopetaskroot exists.
All 19 schemas (or more if PR #862 merged) are enumerated — list is recorded in PROOF.json.
ci-complete.yml job names that ci_gates entries will reference are recorded — no invented names.

steps.task: Author schemas/dcp/dcp_contracts_manifest.schema.json (JSON Schema draft-07) with fields: manifest_version (string), contracts (array of contract entries). Each contract entry: contract_id, schema_file, schema_version, contract_version (semver), validation_state (enum: DESIGN_ONLY|REPO_CROSS_CHECKED|REPO_VALIDATED|LOCKED), level (enum: L0|L1|L2|L3), instance_files (array), runtime_producers (array), runtime_consumers (array), ci_gates (array of strings), enforcement_side (enum: deterministic|llm_advisory|human). All arrays allow empty. additionalProperties: false at entry level. Per design A.2.
validation: python -m json.tool schemas/dcp/dcp_contracts_manifest.schema.json exits 0.
Schema is draft-07, additionalProperties false at contract entry level.
enforcement_side enum includes exactly: deterministic, llm_advisory, human.
validation_state enum includes DESIGN_ONLY, REPO_CROSS_CHECKED, REPO_VALIDATED, LOCKED.

steps.task: Author schemas/dcp/manifest.json: one contract entry per schema currently in schemas/dcp/ (enumerate HEAD state — do not invent entries for schemas not present). Set contract_version=0.1.0 for all, level=L0 unless the plan/design specifies higher, validation_state per evidence. enforcement_side=deterministic for red-lane enforcement schemas, llm_advisory or human as documented. ci_gates entries must name jobs/steps that actually exist in ci-complete.yml — record UNKNOWN for any gate name that cannot be confirmed from S1. Per design A.2.
validation: python -m json.tool schemas/dcp/manifest.json exits 0.
python -m jsonschema -i schemas/dcp/manifest.json schemas/dcp/dcp_contracts_manifest.schema.json exits 0.
Every schema file currently in schemas/dcp/ has exactly one entry in manifest.json — no unlisted, no extra.
No ci_gates entry names a job/step that does not exist in ci-complete.yml (UNKNOWN entries must be explicitly labeled in a comment or noted in PROOF.json, not silently included as if real).
L2 entries have non-empty runtime_producers and runtime_consumers.

steps.task: Author tests/dcp/test_contracts_consistency.py: (1) parse manifest.json, (2) assert every schema_file entry exists on disk, (3) for each entry with ci_gates non-empty, assert each gate name appears as a job or step name in .github/workflows/ci-complete.yml — a fake gate name must cause the test to fail (demonstrate with a fixture or parametrize), (4) assert every L2 entry has non-empty runtime_producers and runtime_consumers. Per design A.1.
validation: python -m pytest tests/dcp/test_contracts_consistency.py -v exits 0 against the authored manifest.
Test fails (exit non-zero) when a ci_gates entry names a job that does not exist in ci-complete.yml — demonstrate with a parametrized fake name or inline assertion fixture.
Test fails when an L2 entry has empty runtime_producers or runtime_consumers.

steps.task: Author docs/90-adr/adr-dcp-deterministic-vs-llm-boundary.md: include the L0-L3 ladder definition, the version-precedence rule (schema_version is the authority marker; contract_version semver is operational), and the det-vs-LLM boundary table mapping each surface (native_hooks.py PreToolUse, pre-commit, CI gates, dopemux dcp CLI, .claude/commands skills, personas/agents, PostToolUse/Stop hooks) to its side and hard-block capability. Per design A.3 and A.2. Update schemas/dcp/README.md with the L0-L3 ladder and version-precedence rule (additive only — do not remove existing content).
validation: ADR file exists and contains the L0-L3 ladder, version-precedence rule, and the 7-row det-vs-LLM surface table.
ADR states: 'a probabilistic guard is a vibe plane, not a red-lane gate' (verbatim from design A.3 constraints).
README.md is additive — original content preserved, ladder and precedence rule appended or integrated.
Both files parse as UTF-8 text with no trailing whitespace issues (git diff --check passes).

steps.task: Author proof/DMX-DCP-TOOLING-101/APPROVAL.json (hand-authored, per design B.6): manifest.json is a new contract-surface file — this TP is the one introducing it, so the sanctioned-change protocol applies. Fields: tp_id, decision (allow), requester (implementer identity), approver (distinct operator identity — must differ from requester), scope (paths this approval covers: [schemas/dcp/manifest.json, schemas/dcp/dcp_contracts_manifest.schema.json]), head_sha (the commit SHA at signing — record PENDING if not yet committed, update before final commit), expiry_window, rationale. Approver must not equal requester.

scope array covers schemas/dcp/manifest.json and schemas/dcp/dcp_contracts_manifest.schema.json.
